evidence.reason: `number_page` admits every non-null `mergedAt` at line 481, including fractional-second ISO-8601 values. Because the timestamp parser only accepts whole seconds, such an in-window merge becomes `unsupported` downstream, is not enrolled, and does not prevent `complete_through` from advancing. That is an ordinary correctness defect against the documented DateTime boundary; the smallest fix is to parse fractional seconds or block completion for unsupported in-window merges.
